scope.quote: The scope of this journal comprises all IEEE fields of interest

ai_policy.quote: shall be disclosed in the acknowledgments section of any article submitted to an IEEE publication.

rules.quote: using a required IEEE Access template
rules.requirement: Use the IEEE Access template.
Define abbreviations and acronyms at first use in the article.
rules.quote: Authors must define abbreviations and acronyms the first time they are used in the article

rules.requirement: Identify article sections containing AI-generated content and explain the level of its use.
rules.quote: specific sections of the article that use AI-generated content shall be identified and accompanied by a brief explanation

rules.requirement: Disclose AI-generated content in the acknowledgments section.
rules.quote: shall be disclosed in the acknowledgments section of any article submitted to an IEEE publication.

rules.requirement: Identify the AI system used for AI-generated content.
rules.quote: The AI system used shall be identified

rules.requirement: For AI-generated text, cite the AI system in affected sections.
rules.quote: The sections of the paper that use AI-generated text shall have a citation to the AI system

rules.requirement: Submit original writing that enhances the subject area.
rules.quote: The article must be original writing that enhances the existing body of knowledge

rules.requirement: Include short biographies for all authors below the references.
rules.quote: biographies of all authors should be included directly within the article below the references section.
Any change to the author list after the article has been submitted is considered rare and exceptional
rules.requirement: Treat post-submission author-list changes as exceptional and subject to editor approval.

rules.quote: All authors should be listed on both the source file
rules.requirement: List all authors in both source and PDF files.
Present conclusions clearly and support them with data.
rules.quote: Conclusions must be presented clearly and supported by the data.

rules.requirement: If expanding a prior conference article, cite the source article.
rules.quote: or the source article is not referenced, the article will be rejected.

rules.requirement: If expanding a prior conference article, describe the connection in the manuscript.
rules.quote: authors are expected to describe the connection in the manuscript

rules.requirement: If expanding a prior conference article, disclose the connection in the cover letter.
rules.quote: disclose it in the cover letter
as long as the similarity is less than 35%.
rules.requirement: For an expanded conference article, keep similarity below 35%.
For a reused copyrighted illustration in a review, obtain permission and credit its source.
rules.quote: you must obtain permission from the copyright holder and cite and properly credit the source references

rules.requirement: Prepare the manuscript in double-column format.
rules.quote: prepared in a double column, single-spaced format

rules.requirement: Do not submit the article elsewhere at the same time.
rules.quote: The article should not be submitted elsewhere at the same time.

rules.requirement: Check that the article contains no fabricated content, including fabricated references.
rules.quote: any article found to include fabricated content of any kind will be promptly rejected.

rules.requirement: Check the article for standard English grammar.
rules.quote: Article must be written in standard English with correct grammar.
minimum of 3 (and a maximum of 10) manuscript keywords
rules.requirement: Select 3 to 10 submission keywords.

rules.quote: required to select a manuscript type upon submission.
rules.requirement: Select the appropriate manuscript type at submission.
Describe experiments, statistics, and analyses in sufficient detail.
rules.quote: described in sufficient detail.
will no longer accept submitted papers which include the ‘Lena image’.
rules.requirement: Do not include the Lena image in the manuscript.

rules.quote: does not permit the submission of multi-part articles
rules.requirement: Submit one complete article rather than a multi-part series.

rules.quote: you can designate only one person as the corresponding author.
rules.requirement: Designate one corresponding author at submission.
Include appropriate references to related prior published works.
rules.quote: Appropriate references to related prior published works must be included.

rules.requirement: Check each reference for accuracy.
rules.quote: carefully check each reference for accuracy

rules.requirement: Include only references relevant to the work.
rules.quote: Do not include references that are not relevant to your work

rules.requirement: For each reviewer comment in an invited resubmission, document the concern, response, and changes.
rules.quote: 1) reviewers’ concerns, 2) authors’ response to the concerns, 3) actual changes implemented.

rules.requirement: For an invited resubmission after rejection, include a separate complete list of updates.
rules.quote: a complete “list of updates” must be included in a separate document.

rules.requirement: Check that the reference list does not include retracted works.
rules.quote: ensure that they have not been retracted

rules.requirement: Ensure the article falls within IEEE fields of interest.
rules.quote: The scope of this journal comprises all IEEE fields of interest

rules.requirement: Prepare the manuscript with single spacing.
rules.quote: prepared in a double column, single-spaced format

rules.requirement: Ensure source and PDF content matches exactly.
rules.quote: The content on each file must match exactly.
File sizes should not exceed 40MB.
rules.requirement: Keep each manuscript submission file at or below 40 MB.
Ensure the submitting author has a public, populated ORCID profile linked to the submission account.
rules.quote: The ORCID profile must be publicly visible and populated.

rules.requirement: If applicable, prepare supplementary material for peer review at submission.
rules.quote: If applicable to your research, have any supplementary material for review ready for the submission process.
Have specific research questions, goals, scope, and inclusion and exclusion criteria.
rules.requirement: State research questions, goals, scope, and inclusion/exclusion criteria in a survey.
For a Survey, explain the literature search and screening procedure.
rules.quote: Explain the literature search and screening procedure.
Compare and contrast the competitive methods
rules.requirement: Compare competing methods on defined technical criteria in a topical review.

rules.quote: Demonstrate the need and novelty of the Topical Review
rules.requirement: Explain why a topical review is needed and timely relative to recent reviews.
For a Topical Review, specify research questions, goals, and scope.
rules.quote: Have specific research questions, goals, and scope.

rules.requirement: For a Tutorial, state its objectives and prerequisite background in the introduction.
rules.quote: The objectives and prerequisite background required by the reader should be clearly identified in the introduction.

rules.requirement: Upload video with the article so it can be peer reviewed.
rules.quote: all video must be peer reviewed with the article.
video (maximum file size is 100MB)
rules.requirement: Keep any submitted video at or below 100 MB.

rules.quote: A Word or LaTex file and a PDF file are both required
rules.requirement: Submit a Word or LaTeX source file and a PDF.
